title: A Treatise on Slowed Time
summary: A treatise on stretching a single moment around a body or a blow until an opponent is stalled and a poison or a pain has time to wane.

title: The Temporal Field Compendium
summary: A compendium on spreading time qi round the body as a living field where the pace of every thing can be read and bent and healed.

title: The Twin Pulse Treatise
summary: A treatise on running two pulses of time through the body at once so that one hand is quick and the other slow and the two strike as one.

title: The Hawk and Moment Compendium
summary: A compendium on seeing a single moment as the hawk sees it and stooping through the gap between two blinks of the guard.

title: The Wind-Sworn Pace Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of pace that a wind-sworn student swears and keeps on the breath and hands to allies along a held bearing.

title: The Oath of the Held Moment
summary: A sworn manual of holding one moment fast in a body or a wound and releasing it at the word that ends the oath.
